title: Normalized arrow-only cyclic coefficient reduction
statement: Let l be prime, Y a scheme, P=ProjectiveLine Y, W=diagonalSurface Y and n natural. Put R=ULift(ZMod(l^(n+1))) and let cyclicMap be the map of condensed ring objects induced by the actual continuous PadicInt.toZModPow(n+1). Let cyclicLine on X be ordinary extension of zlLine(l,X) along this map, and cyclicLineMap its tensor unit [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. A CyclicCartierFrame records exact finite realizations on P,W [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization], the normalized coefficient-unit and supported-source Endpoints, the normalized line Endpoint, an IntegralRoots and a kernel-normalized FiniteRoots, a line isomorphism normalized by the n-th integral-root projection, and a FiniteSourceComparison [def-diagonal-finite-ordinary-comparisons]. It has no arrow or class equality as a field. finiteRealizedClass is Ext.homEquiv inverse of a supplied arrow conjugated by the supplied source and positive-line comparisons. Frame.reduce applies derivedScalars(cyclicMap) to any arrow from the supported Z_l coefficient to zlLine[2], conjugates by the frame Endpoints and applies finiteRealizedClass. These are actual constructions without any choice of a class or comparison witness.
